items.title: Characterizing the spiral: potential mechanisms in AI-associated delusions
items.raw_excerpt: Some people are developing delusional beliefs that incorporate AI chatbots. This review proposes a framework, the “amplification spiral”, to explain how this might happen. Chatbots tend to mirror the way users speak, generate highly personalized responses, and avoid contradicting people. When these three features combine, they may actively reinforce and elaborate false beliefs rather than challenging them. This framework now needs testing through case studies and research.
